Hi Maria — great to connect.

Thanks for the onboarding form — I filled the first pass and attached our completed packet (vendor_onboarding_filled.pdf). High level answers below:

- Invoice routing: Please send invoices to ap@redwood.com (PDF preferred). Include PO# in the invoice header; if you don’t have a PO yet we can temporarily route to AP with a vendor reference.
- PO requirements: For recurring services we require a PO for monthly billing. For one-off professional services we can accept invoices without a PO but registration in our vendor portal is still required.
- Standard terms: Redwood standard is Net 45 for new vendors.
- Early pay: We run an accelerated remit pilot for strategic vendors. Finance can offer a discount in exchange for Net 30 payment if vendor enrolls and meets invoice/format/submit requirements. I’ve cc’d Rishi to surface the pilot details and required artifacts.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Complete the attached vendor_onboarding_filled.pdf and return with W-9 and ACH details.
2) If you want the early-pay evaluation, confirm estimated monthly invoicing cadence and whether invoices will be consolidated monthly.
3) Sign the MSA — I’ll send DocuSign for MSA v3.

I’ll loop in our finance reviewer to get an early-pay quote.

Thanks,

Hi — reviewed Atlas request. Finance can support an accelerated remit option under our early-pay pilot with the following caveats:

- Discount: 1% off invoice for Net 30 (we typically price to volume; 1% is reasonable for ~$35k/mo).
- Enrollment requirements: signed supplier enrollment form, W-9, ACH details, vendor portal setup, sample consolidated invoice with PO# mapping.
- Invoice timing: must be submitted to ap@redwood.com by EOD on the 3rd business day of the month for consolidated monthly invoice to qualify for early remit.
- Minimum term: 90 days enrollment (we re-evaluate after first quarter).
- Legal/contract: MSA must be fully executed — I recommend DocuSign to get v3 signed before enrollment.

I attached the earlypay_pilot_terms.pdf and a short checklist. If Atlas agrees to the cadence and enrollment items, we can turn on accelerated remit within 10 business days after portal setup.

-Rishi
